== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Orgrith Cave is a dangerous location situated at the southeastern edge of the [[Latari Forest]]. The cave exerts a corrupting influence on its surroundings, causing nearby vegetation to wither and the soil to turn into sand. It is characterized by a large, irregular [[stone]] dome that serves as its exterior, though the entrance is wide enough to accommodate many people. The cave was created during a violent conflict involving [[Tartarus]], [[Naraka]], and [[Ornheim Travelers]]. Because of its origins in this chaotic battle, the internal caverns are constantly shifting and remain highly lethal. The interior contains various tunnels and large spaces, including areas where summoned creatures made of [[stone]], [[steel]], or flame can be found. Historically, the site served as both the conclusion of a great battle and the starting point for another.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Situated in the southeastern corner of the [[Latari Forest]], Orgrith Cave was originally formed during a chaotic and terrible battle between [[Naraka]], [[Tartarus]], and the [[Ornheim Travelers]]. The site serves as the designated location for the [[graduation ritual]]. While [[Simon]] had entered the cave at an earlier time, it is also a place where [[Andra Agnos|Andra]] and [[Lycus]] may have become trapped.}}
